preconditions.expression: isinstance(K, int) and K >= 1 and K <= 10**12
preconditions.description: K is a positive integer within the constraint bounds (1 ≤ K ≤ 10¹²).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= n <= 10**12 for n in [find_kth_magical_number(K) for K in range(1, 1000)])
postconditions.description: For any valid K, the returned number n is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ n ≤ 10¹²).
The returned number n is magical, meaning the sum of the products of all non-empty subsequences of its digits is even.

postconditions.expression: all(find_kth_magical_number(K1) < find_kth_magical_number(K2) for K1, K2 in [(1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 5)])
postconditions.description: The returned numbers are strictly increasing with K (i.e., the K-th magical number is greater than the (K-1)-th).
The first magical number is 0, as its only subsequence product is 0 (even).
The second magical number is 2, as its subsequence products sum to 2 (even).
The fifth magical number is 8, as its subsequence products sum to 8 (even).
